messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff staged rollout v3.22.0 -> region 'serving-eu' at 5% traffic. rollout_id=r-325555. change-window 2026-04-21T01:00Z-02:00Z.
rachel: release notes published? need support blurb and short changelog link.
release-bot: Notes: https://release.redwood.com/3.22.0	 highlights: cache restore guard, batching scheduler tweak, embed retry backoff.
diego: watching eu metrics. will call out anything unusual.
yusuf: eu-west-1 p95 embeds jumped 95ms -> 220ms at ~01:04Z, sampled 5xx ~0.4% (not paging yet).
rachel: prefer containment not full abort. option: throttle eu to 1% and run focused smoke. command: `deployctl adjust --id r-325555 --region eu --percent 1`
deploy-bot: Adjusting rollout r-325555: region eu target percent -> 1%... done.
diego: smoke after throttle: errors down to 0.07%, p95 back to ~110ms. one host still showing 502s on warmup path. logs indicate kvcache restore delay and elevated memory during restore.
yusuf: mitigation: pin affected host group in eu-west-1 back to v3.21.9 while we prepare a minimal guard fix. command: `releasectl pin --region eu-west-1 --hostgroup hg-7 --version v3.21.9`
rachel: +1 from PM. keep other regions moving at reduced rate. add a short customer note: "Targeted rollback in eu-west-1 due to cache warmup regression; staged rollout continues at reduced rate."
deploy-bot: releasectl: pin applied for eu-west-1 hostgroup hg-7 -> v3.21.9.
diego: post-pin smoke looks good; errors cleared on the pinned hosts. monitoring for 20m at 1% before any lift.
yusuf: standing by to expand pin if 5xx > 0.5% for 10m.
rachel: noted. follow-up: add a preflight kvcache-config alignment step to rollout checklist and capture this thread for post-release review. thanks all. :thumbsup:
